The '''Borloria system''' was located in the [[Dentari sector/Legends|Dentari sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Borlorian]]s.<ref name="Galladinium" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Borloria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
